applies_why: Yes: the judge resolves a collision between CR2's chain read with Isaiah 8:8 and 9:6-7 and DR3's pressed sign bounds by relying on what the sign verse itself states.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse: one reading forbids deciding the collision by the silence or wording of a single sign verse; the other permits treating a single verse's silence as one datum while still weighing chains by footing.
why: Because the judge decides underdetermined by the silence of Isaiah 7:14 itself, it applies a verse-level silence test instead of weighing the CR2 chain against DR3's pressed chain by footing.
